purpose: Recurring locators for source-grounded semantic review under WRITING; inspect every element against read sources, preserve scientific definitions, conditions, quantities, uncertainty and attribution, and exclude the rhetoric prohibited by Common output.

uncertainty.repair: State the supported finding directly; retain saved standard errors, intervals or p values.

negative-contrast.repair: Write the adopted action, identified quantity or corrected specification in affirmative clauses. Preserve estimates, intervals and actual evidence.

defensive-framing.repair: State the adopted comparison, exact specification and economic consequence directly. Keep the actual sufficient restriction in its scientific role and omit prerequisite announcements or added-premise plans.

disclaimer.repair: Delete the disclaimer sentence and retain the supported action or result.

supplement.repair: Give the actual saved value or requested comparison. Keep routine reporting and computation arrangements in the worksheet.

ornament.repair: Replace the value judgment with the actor, action and saved quantitative result.
